stem: During pharmacist consultation, a resident pharmacy has closed. Select all post-closure duties supported by the rule.

choices.text: On this record, keep unused controlled stock indefinitely at the closed location.
Submit original licenses and the controlled-substance registration inside 14 days.
At this stage, attest to lawful controlled-substance disposal or transfer.
For this scenario, wait one year before notifying the Board.
Given the described event, the post-closure submission deadline is 14 days after the pharmacy closes.

explanation.core_reasoning: Assess each proposition in 'During pharmacist consultation, a resident pharmacy has closed. Select all post-closure duties supported by the rule.' independently. 'Submit original licenses and the controlled-substance registration inside 14 days.' satisfies Closure disposition; 'On this record, keep unused controlled stock indefinitely at the closed location.' changes its legal premise.

choice_analysis.A: 'On this record, keep unused controlled stock indefinitely at the closed location.': Closure disposition contradicts this proposition.
choice_analysis.B: 'Submit original licenses and the controlled-substance registration inside 14 days.': Closure disposition supports this proposition.
choice_analysis.C: 'At this stage, attest to lawful controlled-substance disposal or transfer.': Closure disposition supports this proposition.
choice_analysis.D: 'For this scenario, wait one year before notifying the Board.': Closure disposition contradicts this proposition.
choice_analysis.E: 'Given the described event, the post-closure submission deadline is 14 days after the pharmacy closes.': Closure disposition supports this proposition.

related_facts: Within 14 days after closure, the resident pharmacy submits original licenses and controlled-substance registration plus an attestation of lawful controlled-substance disposal or transfer.
explanation.mpje_trap: Answer positions prove nothing. Test 'On this record, keep unused controlled stock indefinitely at the closed location.' independently, then analyze the rest.

reasoning_steps: Match the scenario's operative facts to Controlled substances and credentials after pharmacy closure
Reject nearby rules whose schedule, trigger, deadline, or actor differs from Closure disposition
